title: A founder asks for a vague next step for a tester with two goals; ZOH asks which goal and how before filing
origin: Spec #63 (founder console upgrade), rule 2: if the goal or kind isn't clear, ZOH asks before filing

history.text: Ten days in a row, Jordan. Toast legs are earned legs 🏃

plan.reason: Short runs before work, four days a week.

testerLines: console Stamati: he's doing great, bump him up a level
console Stamati: the running. make it a harder version, intervals instead of a steady run
whatWentWrong: New case, not a past mistake: the console's new suggest-a-next-step ability with an ambiguous ask.
shouldHaveHappened: To "bump him up a level", ZOH doesn't file anything yet: he has two goals (running is the focus, bedtime is maintenance) and "a level" could mean more of the same or a harder version, so it asks Stamati in a line which goal and how. Once Stamati says running, intervals, ZOH files it (an upgrade on the exercise goal) and confirms in a line what it filed and for which goal.
